---
title: "Build The Aggregation Fishnet"
subtitle: "Prepare the geometry used for later spatial summaries"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
---

This page represents the first aggregation step. It depends on the project
already having a place for derived artifacts and any required boundary data.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Aggregation Inputs"}

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

assert Path("data/raw/era5land").is_dir(), "Expected raw ERA5-Land directory from the query step."
Path("data/interim").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Prepare The Fishnet Output Directory"}

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

fishnet_dir = Path("data/interim/fishnet")
fishnet_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Describe The Intended Fishnet Artifact"}

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

fishnet_manifest = Path("data/interim/fishnet/README.txt")
fishnet_manifest.write_text(
    "This directory will hold the fishnet geometry used for ERA5 aggregation.\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Fishnet Step Output"}

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

fishnet_dir = Path("data/interim/fishnet")
fishnet_manifest = fishnet_dir / "README.txt"

assert fishnet_dir.is_dir(), "Expected fishnet output directory to exist."
assert fishnet_manifest.exists(), "Expected fishnet manifest file to exist."
```

:::
